area.title: IT Area
area.description: IT Area, spelled EXACTLY as in DevOps: Consumer | Customer Dev | Make (Business Operation) | Focus Market (Cust Ops) | Commercial Exp | Tech Services | Tax Reform. Never abbreviate, never translate.

year.title: Year
year.description: Portfolio Year, 4 digits. Leave empty to use the current year.

report_html.title: Report HTML
report_html.description: YOU write this, always - never ask the user for it. It is the whole written part of the report, in ENGLISH. SHAPE: open with 3-5 sentences of executive summary - money at stake, where risk sits, the decision you want from leadership. Then your analysis, in as many sub-sections as you like; nothing is mandatory. FRAGMENT only: no , , ,

parameters/Body.query: SELECT [System.Id] FROM WorkItems WHERE [System.TeamProject] = 'CDIO Portfolio' AND [System.State] <> '00 Cancelled' AND [System.State] <> '11 Closed' AND [Custom.PortfolioYear] = @{outputs('Init_Year')} AND [Custom.ITArea] = '@{replace(outputs('Init_Area'), '''', '''''')}' ORDER BY [Custom.ProjectTotalBudget] DESC
